name: sol8-contract-column-fit
goal: Keep contract table labels readable beside long identifiers and types

evidence: Metadata columns in 407f1ab711 leave desktop long identifiers/types unbroken, compressing Requirement and Default words. API long-desktop at 59ec4969c4 shows fragmented short labels.
The existing shared guard checks text presence and bounds, but not fragmentation into character-sized lines. Extend its normal contract viewport matrix with whole-word heading and requirement checks.
Checkpoint e4f1fcd8de fails desktop long-field label readability in the unchanged three-viewport command; immutable failing captures are retained.
Wrap long names/types, reserve readable short labels through intrinsic widths and nowrap headers, and keep the existing stacked narrow layout.
